verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly promise autonomous bug repro-and-fix as a core use case (devin-docs-1), but concrete hands-on evidence undercuts this: an early demo review found it resolved only 13.8% of issues and used questionable fixes like wrapping a KeyError in a try-catch rather than truly diagnosing the root cause, and commenters directly challenge whether an 'AI software engineer' capable of autonomous fixes actually exists as claimed. missing for 10: independent benchmark data confirming high success rate on real-world bug reports, and rebuttal evidence addressing the low resolution-rate criticism.
